worktree.setup: main=$(git worktree list --porcelain | awk '/^worktree / {sub(/^worktree /, ""); print; exit}'); fnm exec --using="$main/.nvmrc" node "$main/packages/alignfirst/bin/alignfirst.mjs" workspace setup
worktree.teardown: main=$(git worktree list --porcelain | awk '/^worktree / {sub(/^worktree /, ""); print; exit}'); fnm exec --using="$main/.nvmrc" node "$main/packages/alignfirst/bin/alignfirst.mjs" workspace teardown
